mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, phone, role_id, openid, avatar, status, password_changed_at, password_expire_at, must_change_password, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_time, last_login_ip, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE openid = #{openid} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, phone, role_id, openid, avatar, status, password_changed_at, password_expire_at, must_change_password, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_time, last_login_ip, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE unit_chain AS ( SELECT u.unit_id, u.parent_id, u.unit_type FROM sys_user su JOIN base_work_unit u ON u.unit_id = su.work_unit_id WHERE su.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.unit_id, parent.parent_id, parent.unit_type FROM base_work_unit parent JOIN unit_chain child ON child.parent_id = parent.unit_id ) SELECT unit_id FROM unit_chain WHERE unit_type = 'D' OR parent_id = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN unit_type = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
